description: This file defines a React component for managing parent input parameter mappings within an asset details page. It handles fetching, displaying, creating, and updating mappings, including modal dialogs and form validation.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches and updates the list of parent input mappings for the selected asset and input parameter.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Internal function called within useEffect to load data asynchronously when dependencies change.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares state for creating a new parent input mapping and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares state for editing an existing parent input mapping and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving the new or edited parent input mapping, including validation, API calls, and error handling.
